weather_line: Fog holding steady in the gorge · ducks at rest · a hum from the south

stories.headline: Stranger Arrives at Ministry Lost Property; Asks After Briefcase by Name; Has No Reason to Know Its Name
stories.byline: By our Ministry correspondent, who is also fine
body: A figure described only as 'unhurried' presented herself at the Ministry of Magic's Lost Property repository at precisely 10:04 this morning, bypassed the queue with no apparent magic, and addressed the duty clerk as follows: 'I believe you have something that belongs to a friend.' The clerk, one T. Pembrook, reports that the visitor knew the briefcase's shelf location, its hum frequency, and the name of the colour one witness had seen — a name, Pembrook adds, that he had not heard before and cannot now recall.

The Department of Mysteries has issued a statement consisting entirely of punctuation. The Office of Unclassified Artefact Management has requested a description of the visitor; no description has been forthcoming, as all three clerks present offer different ones and agree only that she left 'in the direction of the lifts' before the lifts were used. The briefcase, for its part, has gone briefly silent — the hum ceased at 10:07 and has not resumed. This is considered either very good or very bad. The duty roster has been quietly revised.

Unconfirmed reports suggest Pembrook asked the visitor's name. She gave it. Pembrook wrote it down, looked at it, and — after a pause — did not file it. 'Some things,' Pembrook told this correspondent, 'you leave out of the record on purpose.' The Prophet notes this as the most Ministry sentence anyone has spoken all week.

stories.headline: Sunday Comes to the Household; the Household Accepts; Christine Administers the Morning with Characteristic Precision
body: Conditions this morning were assessed as follows: tea, adequate; light, good; Steve's preliminary survey of the back garden, inconclusive but thorough. Christine is understood to have managed the first hour of Sunday with the same quiet authority she brings to a goblin audit — that is to say, nothing went sideways, and everything that might have considered going sideways thought better of it.

Steve reports the enchanted Jeep 'had a peaceful night,' which he says while patting the bonnet in a manner that is either mechanical habit or sincere reassurance. The eleven hatted ducks observed a moment of collective stillness at approximately nine o'clock and then resumed their posts. The household is, by all available measures, in good order. The shelf bracket remains level. Don's portrait nodded once and went back to reading.

stories.headline: Ridgeline Fog Issues Sunday Supplement; Recommends No Particular Urgency; the Gorge Will Be There
stories.byline: Adventure desk, filing from the hollow
body: The Eastern Ridgeline's seasonal fog, now well into its late-summer residency, circulated a brief communiqué this morning advising that all hollows, rock arches, and the lower trail through the narrows remain 'ready when you are.' Sources within the fog describe the gorge as 'patient' and note that the most recent enchanted mud has dried to a surface best described as 'cooperative.' The Jeep's tyres have been informed.

No expedition is confirmed for today, but the Jeep is understood to be quietly available. Steve has looked at the map once, not on purpose, in passing. Christine has not looked at the map. The Prophet's Adventure Desk considers this the natural order of things: one of them plans; one of them gets them out when the plan meets the actual ridge. Both are necessary. The fog agrees.

stories.headline: The Unnamed Department That Does Not Exist Withdraws Its Claim; Declines Comment; Has Not Existed Since Thursday
body: In a development that the Prophet notes with care, the unnamed Ministry department that officially does not exist has quietly withdrawn its competing claim on the briefcase, effective retroactively, from a date that cannot be specified. An owl arrived this morning bearing a single line: 'We never filed.' The Ministry's Artefact Registry, when consulted, confirms there is no record of the claim — which is consistent, clerks say, with either its withdrawal or its never having existed, and 'honestly we've stopped asking which.'

This leaves two active claimants: the Department of Mysteries and the Office of Unclassified Artefact Management. Neither has produced documentation. The briefcase remains on its shelf. The hum remains absent. The name in Pembrook's notebook, wherever he has put it, remains unread.

familiars_corner: Lucy: Lucy has expressed no opinion on the Ministry briefcase situation. She has, however, repositioned herself twice in the last hour so as to be near the window with a view of the lane, and the expression she is wearing is the one that means she is waiting for something she already knows is coming.

Ellie: Ellie discovered this morning that if you sit very close to the window the fog looks like it's moving just for you, and she has been sitting very close to the window for forty minutes. Progress continues. The fog appears flattered.

Jersey: Jersey identified the warmest available lap at 8:14 a.m. and has not required the world to do anything further. He may be asleep. He may simply be very still on purpose. Either way, the lap situation is resolved.
founding_editor_note: That shelf is still level. I'm just saying. It'd stay level in a Category Five. Because I used the right bracket. — D.

in_brief.sport: The Household Recreational Lifting League reports no official events scheduled for Sunday; Christine's form is nonetheless considered current and in good standing.
in_brief.forecast: Fog persistent through midmorning; hollows cooperative; one hum-shaped silence moving east; the afternoon is genuinely open, which is its own kind of forecast.

storyline_updates.title: The Briefcase
storyline_updates.summary: Day 4: A stranger arrived at Lost Property, knew the briefcase by name, location, and hum frequency, and named the unnameable colour. She left before anyone could stop her. The briefcase has gone silent. The unnamed third-claimant department has withdrawn its claim retroactively. Pembrook has a name in his notebook that he has not filed. Day 5 (resolution): the stranger should return, or make contact, and the briefcase's contents — or its purpose — should be revealed or deliberately, perfectly left unresolved in a way that is funnier than any answer. The Pulp Fiction briefcase tradition should be honoured: the glow, the warmth, the satisfaction on the face of the person who opens it, and the fact that we never quite see inside.
